description: Upload a PNG, preview it at 16/32/48/180px, and download a real multi-size favicon.ico.

faqs.a: A genuine ICO file: ICONDIR header plus PNG-compressed 16, 32, and 48px entries.
faqs.q: Is the .ico a real icon file?

faqs.a: Any raster image works, but square PNGs give the cleanest results.
The 180px preview matches apple-touch-icon size; download it as PNG too.
Everything happens in your browser — the image never leaves your machine.

howto: Download favicon.ico (and the 180px PNG if you want).
title: Favicon Preview Tester
